title: Idea thread
author: 12OffIntx
selftext:
Reading through this sub, there is a lot of discussion about originality. I've heard some people saying they want to make a game, but can't think of anything. Of course I've then seen people post examples of games that seem very similar to one or more freely available today on Steam. So, anyone want to volunteer ideas of a game they would want to see built or, if related to something older, rebuilt/revisited?

  
One I would love someone to modernize and put a fresh spin on: Sword of the Stars. I loved that game and its a shame i died after the weaker sequel. I would pay to see that game taken forward. Not sure if AI could do it or not, but could be fun to try!

comments.body: A MMO where it’s like solo leveling, no monster item left behind meaning you can craft gear based on monster items found so let’s say you mix a wolf fang with a dagger now it has high attack speed and if it’s a spider fang now it has poison

replies.author: 12OffIntx
replies.body: That's a cool idea. Sounds like something another guy was building along those lines.
